question: Should OpenClaw replace the single exclusive memory slot with first-class memory role slots in core, or keep memory composition outside core and handle only narrower coexistence fixes?
rationale: The request adds public config and plugin-runtime semantics, and VISION.md both acknowledges the current one-memory-plugin model and welcomes plugin API extensions when useful capability cannot otherwise be built.

options.title: Sponsor role slots
options.body: Continue review on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as core plugin API/config work with explicit migration and compatibility proof.

options.title: Narrow to coexistence repairs
options.body: Keep one memory slot but fix specific warning, activation, or dreaming coexistence cases without committing to a broader role taxonomy.

options.title: Reject core role taxonomy
options.body: Close the architecture direction if maintainers decide OpenClaw should converge on one recommended memory path despite the reported plugin-composition demand.

recommendation.title: Sponsor role slots
recommendation.body: Continue review on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as core plugin API/config work with explicit migration and compatibility proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame points to this area, while the decision is about the product/config boundary around that current implementation.
